summary: Agent 0.33.0: verb probe-identity (ADR-0087, now accepted). As LocalSystem it creates primary tokens (system baseline, restricted: administrators + user SID deny-only, max privileges dropped, medium integrity; localservice via LogonUser) and starts each enabled child once per token on a free probe port (health port number replaced in args/env) inside a kill-on-close job object, measuring start, health, CUDA lines, per-process VRAM and tree end; a copy of the agent under each token checks NVML set-to-current, GPU-Z, process paths, user hives. Started elevated, it re-runs itself once as LocalSystem via a scheduled task, only if its own program cannot be changed by non-admins (childpath rules). Nothing in the running service changes.

findings.evidence: The probe runs as LocalSystem and starts programs; a probe binary in a user-writable folder would hand SYSTEM to whoever can replace it.
findings.resolution: probeViaSystemTask refuses unless the program's file, folder and folders above pass the ADR-0085 exposure check; the scheduled task is removed after the run; the report is written atomically into the configuration folder (SYSTEM/Administrators).

findings.evidence: Probe children could collide with the running children (ports) or outlive the probe.
findings.resolution: Each probe child gets a free port (whole-number replacement of its health port, unit-tested incl. near misses); it runs in its own kill-on-close job, is ended after the measurement, and the report states tree_ended. The upstream child (large model) is excluded unless a reason is given.

findings.evidence: NVML permission is tested by writing the power limit.
findings.resolution: Set to the current value read just before (a no-op); under tokens without the right NVML refuses with rc 4 - measured as the normal user: denied, matching the 2026-09-24 measurement of the virtual account.

findings.evidence: The report includes the last output lines of a child that failed.
findings.resolution: Only for failed or CUDA-error children, at most 25 lines; children's logs carry no secrets by design (log hygiene); the report lies in the admin-only configuration folder.

tests.command: go test ./... (Windows and Linux/WSL), gofmt, go vet (linux, windows)
tests.evidence: new probe_identity_test.go (options, child selection, port replacement, CUDA reading) and probe_identity_windows_test.go (restricted token not admin and medium integrity; stand-in child under it: started, healthy on its own probe port, CUDA seen, tree ended).

tests.command: probe-identity --inner-rights as the normal user; probe-identity without elevation
tests.evidence: NVML denied (rc 4), process paths 448 of 655, hives 1 of 1; without elevation: refused with the next step.

limitations: The full measurement on a node (as LocalSystem, real children) has not run yet; it needs the operator's administrator rights.
LOCAL SERVICE stands in for the virtual service account in the rights check.
